Preset: Sets Feed and Kill from a pattern preset: coral, mitosis, labyrinth, spots or worms. custom uses your own values.
Feed: Gray-Scott feed rate. The interesting range is narrow, about 0.02-0.07.
Kill: Gray-Scott kill rate. Together with Feed it sets the pattern type.
Steps: Solver iterations per frame. More = faster pattern growth but slower.
Play: On: run the simulation. Off: freeze it.
Reset: Pulse: re-seed the simulation from in1 and the random blobs.
Feedmod: How strongly image luminance shifts Feed per pixel. 0 = uniform.
Killmod: How strongly image luminance shifts Kill per pixel. 0 = uniform.
Inject: Continuous injection of chemical B where the image is brighter than Seedthreshold. 0 = none.
Seedamount: Strength of the image seeding at Reset.
Seedthreshold: Luminance above which the image seeds or injects B.
Invert: On: dark areas drive seeding and injection instead of bright ones.
Sprinkle: Amount of random blobs added at Reset so flat images still grow a pattern.
Colormode: tint, multiply and emboss apply the pattern to the image. ramp: colours from Color1-4. field: grey field. warp: refracts the image.
Strength: How strongly the pattern affects the image.
Contrast: Gain applied to the pattern before rendering.
Bump: Strength of the relief (emboss and lighting).
Color1: First stop (low values) of the 4-colour ramp.
Color4: Fourth stop (high values) of the 4-colour ramp.
Diffb: Diffusion rate of chemical B; keep below Diffusion A.
Dt: Simulation time step. Keep at or below 1 for stability.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
